title: South Korea thrash Thailand 3-0 to top Asian Cup qualifying group
summary_from_source: South Korea cruised to a commanding 3-0 victory over Thailand in Asian Cup qualifying on Friday, with Son Heung-min scoring twice and Hwang Hee-chan adding a third. The result puts South Korea firmly at the top of their qualifying group with a perfect record. Manager Kim Pan-gon praised the team's tactical discipline and clinical finishing in front of a sold-out Seoul World Cup Stadium.

title: Lee Kang-in completes record-breaking move to Real Madrid from PSG
summary_from_source: South Korean international Lee Kang-in has completed his transfer from Paris Saint-Germain to Real Madrid in a deal worth approximately 80 million euros, making it the highest transfer fee ever paid for a Korean player. The 25-year-old attacking midfielder has signed a five-year contract at the Bernabeu. Lee is expected to compete for a starting role alongside Jude Bellingham in Carlo Ancelotti's squad.

title: KFA doubles youth development programme footprint ahead of 2030 World Cup bid
summary_from_source: The Korea Football Association has announced a major expansion of its elite youth development programme, the KFA Dream Team Project, doubling its reach from six to twelve cities nationwide. The initiative targets players aged 10 to 15 and combines intensive football training with academic support. KFA officials stated that the expansion is part of a broader strategy to build a sustainable pipeline of talent in preparation for the country's 2030 FIFA World Cup co-hosting bid with North Korea, China, and Japan.
